title: crepidiastrum sonchifolium subsp. pubescens
intro: Crepidiastrum sonchifolium subsp. pubescens, commonly known as a type of plant in the Asteraceae family, is a species that has been used in traditional medicine. It is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Crepidiastrum sonchifolium subsp. pubescens include antiseptic and antirheumatic actions, which can help to heal wounds and alleviate joint pain. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
